items: **Writing History.** NEO records how you write, keystroke by keystroke. History, in a book's footer, plays the writing back day by day; any chapter or paragraph goes back to an earlier moment with one click; and you can tag a moment with a name and a note. It's on from the start, since a history can't be recorded afterwards; change it in NEO → Options… (File → Options… on Windows and Linux) → Writing History. The history stays with your book, and nothing is sent anywhere.

**Proof of when you wrote.** Since a timestamp can't be added afterwards, NEO asks once, before anything is sent: say yes, and as you write, two independent timestamp services sign a fingerprint of your history (never your words). Record Only sends nothing; change it any time in Options. File → Export → Writing History… makes one web page that anyone can open, offline, to watch the book being written and check the timestamps for themselves.
**NEO Pocket records too** (⋯ → Options… → Writing History), and plays the history back on your phone.

**NEO Options.** NEO → Options… (File → Options… on Windows and Linux) gathers NEO's features in one place: outline cards, notes pages, poetry, footnotes, pen names, page views, focus, vim keys, more exports and the rest. Turn on what you use; the menus show only what's on.
**NEO Pocket gets Options as well** (⋯ → Options…): outline cards, notes pages, poetry, footnotes, pen names, vim keys and plain text, Markdown and web page exports, on when you want them.
